name: settleview_event_loop_stalls

query_condition.sql: SELECT max(value) AS n FROM "settleview_event_loop_stalls" HAVING max(value) >= 3

row_template: {n} stalls over 500 ms in the last hour
description: App event loop stalling: screens and orders lag.

context_attributes.slo: Fewer than 3 event-loop stalls (over 500 ms) an hour.
